Clinical significance:

The rapid rise in HCG Serum levels after conception makes it an excellent marker for early confirmation and monitoring of pregnancy.HCG levels can be useful in prediction of spontaneous abortions, Aiding in the detection of ectopic pregnancy and multiple gestation. For diagnostic purpose, Results should always be assessed in conjunction with the patient’s medical history, clinical examination and other findings.

 

Please correlate with Clinical Conditions.
